answer: Amines are derivatives of ammonia ($NH_3$) where one or more hydrogen atoms are replaced by alkyl or aryl groups. They are classified as: Primary ($1^\circ$, $R-NH_2$), one group; Secondary ($2^\circ$, $R_2NH$), two groups; Tertiary ($3^\circ$, $R_3N$), three groups.
